Key Outreach started in Louisville, where hard work, accountability, and consistency are expected.
Those values shaped how we operate and continue to guide the way we work today.
We believe lead generation should be predictable.
Companies shouldn't have to rely on referrals, guesswork, or founder-led prospecting to create opportunities and grow.
Why We Started
Key Outreach
Outbound was often treated as a series of one-off campaigns rather than a repeatable system. Activity was high, but pipeline remained inconsistent, and we kept seeing the same problem across industries.
‍
Inside software companies, agencies, and service firms, founders were spending time prospecting instead of leading, while sales teams were relying on guesswork instead of a defined process.
‍
We built Key Outreach to change that.
ESTABLISHED IN 2015, LOUISVILLE, USA.
